## Slides are level-2 headings

Each `##` starts a new slide.

- A `#` heading becomes a full-screen section divider.
- `. . .` reveals the content after it on a click.

. . .

Like this.

# A section divider {.subsection}

## Content boxes

::: {.content-box-marine}
[The key point]{.box-title}

[Use `[Title]{.box-title}` inside a box — never a `###` heading, which revealjs
would turn into a separate slide.]{.box-body}
:::

::: {.content-box-oil}
Supporting detail.
:::

## Code

```{r}
#| echo: true
1 + 1
```

Speaker notes go in a `.notes` div and are visible in speaker view (press `s`).
